pdfu.not_pdf: {name} is not a PDF. Choose .pdf files, or use Import drawing for other formats.
wpw.lead: New 3D points are placed on the work plane. Put it on a level, on a reference plane, on a face or through three points.
wpw.no_ref_hint: Draw one with Reference plane on the Architecture tab.
mep.err.cut_ends: Choose a point on a straight part of the run, away from its ends and bends.
mep.err.cut_device: This run connects a device. Insert the fitting on the run it joins.
mep.err.same_size: The new size is the same as the run's. Choose another size.
fit.lead: Choose what to insert into the selected run. The network checks the fitting fits and refuses it whole when it does not.
fit.err.one: Select one duct, pipe, tray or conduit run first.
cls.lead: A classification system is a text parameter Classification.<system>. Type a code and assign it to the selection or to every element of its categories.
cls.empty_hint: Select the elements to classify, then come back here.
cls.err.no_system: Type the name of the classification system.
cls.err.long_system: The system name is too long.
cls.err.not_text: A parameter with this name exists and does not hold text per element. Choose another system name.
wprof.lead: The wall's outline seen from its start side: along the wall from its start, height above its base. Drag the points or type them.
wprof.none: The wall has no profile yet
wprof.err.number: Every point needs a number along and up.
wprof.err.outside: Points must stay between the wall's start and end.
wprof.err.few: The outline needs at least three points that enclose an area.
wprof.err.cross: The outline crosses itself. Move a point so the edges do not cross.
why.level.text: It belongs to level {level}: it moves with the level's elevation.
why.top_roof.text: Its top is attached to roof {id}: it follows the roof's shape.
why.top_level.text: Its top is tied to level {level} with offset {offset}: it follows that level.
why.top_slab.text: Its top is attached to slab {id}: it follows the slab's underside.
why.profile.text: It has an edited elevation profile, so its outline is not a rectangle. Edit profile changes or removes it.
why.top_flat.text: Its top is flat at {h} above its base.
why.base_slab.text: Its base is attached to slab {id}: it follows the slab's top.
why.base_offset.text: Its base is {offset} off its level.
why.join_off.text: Joins are switched off at its {end}: it stops short of the walls it meets there.
why.join_kind.text: At its {end} it meets the next wall with a {kind} join.
why.rule.text: A dimension rule holds it: {rule}. Edits that break the rule are refused.
why.openings.text: It hosts {n} doors, windows or openings: they move with it and are cut out of it.
why.pinned.text: It is pinned: moving and deleting it are refused until you unpin it.
why.group.text: It belongs to group {name} with {n} copies: a change to one copy goes to every copy.
why.phase.text: It is created in phase {phase}: views of earlier phases do not show it.
why.demolished.text: It is demolished in phase {phase}: views of later phases do not show it.
why.none_hint: Select one element and this window explains it.
where.lead: Type what you are looking for in your own words, for example the name another program uses for it.
where.examples: For example: schedule, hatch, layers, revision cloud.
where.context: On the Modify tab when such an element is selected
where.app: In the app bar and the command palette
